steps.body: Dividing by 3 asks how many groups of 3 fit — or how many are in each of 3 equal shares.
steps.narration: Dividing by 3 asks how many groups of 3 fit — or how many are in each of 3 equal shares.

widget.prompt: Build an array with 3 rows that holds 21 squares.
widget.factorFeedback: That rectangle covers 21 squares, but not as 3 rows of 7. Build the arrangement the fact describes.
widget.successFeedback: 21 split into 3 rows gives 7 in each.
widget.lowFeedback: That is fewer than 21 squares. Keep building until the array is complete.
widget.highFeedback: That is more than 21 squares. The array should stop at 3 rows of 7.

predict.reveal: Division undoes multiplication: the quotient is the factor that is not the divisor. If 18 were right, 18 groups of 3 would rebuild 54, not 21.
